items.title: Jerry Jerome interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: And later Charlie Christian joined, in the sextet. ... Charlie was with the band, I know a lot of things about Charlie, and in return the guy sent me literally a diary of the time that I was with Benny, when Charlie was with the band.

ctx.x: That’s a great story. In that Goodman group, is that the one that had Teddy Wilson?
Yeah. Teddy and Lionel. And later Charlie Christian joined, in the sextet. Fabulous band.
